rules.platform: Dell Inspiron / Vostro / Latitude (AMI Aptio V NVAR)
rules.description: Zeros AMITSESetup and __KEYM__ variables in the active NVRAM bank, removing Administrator & System passwords.
rules.action: Zero out (0x00) the password token / hash payload inside AMITSESetup and Key Manager (__KEYM__) while preserving DMI block (_WB_).

rules.description: Fixes 'Alert! TPM device is not detected' error by restoring clean Intel CSME 11.8 Corporate LP firmware and clearing initialized/corrupt PTT state.
rules.action: Clean Intel CSME Region (replace dirty ME region with clean configured repository donor binary). TPM 2.0 re-initializes upon next boot.

rules.description: Dell Service Tag, PPID, Asset Tag and Windows Product Key are stored in the _WB_ block (typically at 0x010C4000 - 0x010C6FFF).
rules.action: Never erase or overwrite the _WB_ block during Dell BIOS rebuilding/patching.
